definitions.explanation: Reluctance to let go; continued attachment to something that is over.

examples.japanese: {元|もと}カノに{未練|みれん}がある。
examples.english: I still have feelings for my ex-girlfriend.

examples.japanese: {未練|みれん}を{断|た}ち{切|き}る。
{未練|みれん}たらしい{態度|たいど}を{取|と}るな。

notes: Often used about past relationships or opportunities. {未練|みれん}がましい or {未練|みれん}たらしい describe someone who can't let go. Can be seen as a negative trait (inability to move on).
